main:1.text: Nightmare is the first episode of Alan Wake. It is divided into three parts. The first, A Writer's Dream, follows writer Alan Wake as he tries to survive an attack by a possessed hitchhiker in a nightmare. The second part, Welcome to Bright Falls, depicts his arrival with his wife, Alice, in Bright Falls, Washington.

main:2.text: Taken is the second episode of Alan Wake. It is divided into two parts. The first, Bright Falls Sheriff Station, which takes place at the tiular location, follows Alan Wake after being found by Sheriff Sarah Breaker the previous episode.

main:3.text: Ransom is the third episode of Alan Wake. It is divided into two parts. The first, On the Run, follows Alan Wake as he is chased by local authorities lead by the FBI Agent Robert Nightingale. The second part, Mirror Peak, follows Wake on his journey to meet with his wife's kidnapper on the titular location.

main:4.text: The Truth is the fourth episode of Alan Wake. It is divided into three parts. The first, Cauldron Lake Lodge, takes place at the titular location and follows Alan Wake after being rescued by Emil Hartman, who claims that everything he has experienced was just a product of his imagination.

main:5.text: The Clicker is the fifth episode of Alan Wake. It is divided into two parts. In the first, Night Life in Bright Falls, Alan Wake fights his way through the town with Sheriff Sarah Breaker and Barry Wheeler to reach a rescue helicopter that can take them to Cynthia Weaver, who holds the key to stopping the Dark Presence.

main:6.text: Departure is the sixth episode of Alan Wake. It is divided into two parts: the first, The Road to Cauldron Lake, follows Wake as he makes his way to the lake as the Dark Presence does everything in its power to stop him. The Dark Place follows Wake as he navigates through the surreal titular location to reach Bird Leg Cabin and write the ending for "Departure" to free Alice.
